text:
maya: Heads-up — recurring missing spans pattern detected across 3 ETL runs in the last 48h. Postmortem hinted at a join that drops rows when seq_id is null. Need to assign remediation owners + timelines.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created (P2) — Observability span loss. Details: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042
kevin: ack. can you paste an example log or the SQL causing the drop?
maya: here's an example query and a sample log where spans disappear mid-window:
```sql
SELECT s.* FROM spans_raw s
LEFT JOIN service_meta m ON s.service_id = m.id
WHERE s.seq_id IS NOT NULL;
```
and the log snippet: `span_processor: dropped 120 spans due to missing service_id`
jess: I can take the aggregation + join robustness fix. Plan: make join tolerant, add defensive checks, and add unit + integration tests to assert no silent drops. ETA: EOW for patch, migration/backfill next week. @data-eng will need to run backfill.
data-eng: can run backfill Tue-Wed next week. need estimate of affected rows and a safe maintenance window. prefer shard-by-service_id to avoid impact.
kevin: I'll add a gap detection alert and a small dashboard. Proposed alert: when missing-spans ratio > 0.5% over 5m, fire. Will also add a trace SLO check. ETA: 48h.
sre-rotation: is this customer affecting or internal telemetry only? do we need any rollbacks?
maya: internal telemetry only right now — no customer-facing regressions found. No rollback planned. root cause still being validated but matches postmortem hypothesis.
jess: Action summary (proposed):
1) jess — aggregation/join fix + tests (ETA 3 days)
2) data-eng — backfill plan + run (ETA 5 days)
3) kevin — alert + dashboard + SLO tweak (ETA 48h)
4) maya — update postmortem doc with repro + regression tests (ETA 2 days)
Also propose recurring check-ins weekly for 4 weeks to watch for recurrence. please ACK and I will add to remediation tracker.
kevin: +1. I'll create tasks in the remediation board and assign owners.
maya: tracker link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/observability-remediations (added initial timeline & repro steps)
data-eng: noted the ETL lag spikes overlapped with compaction job last night — I'll coordinate to avoid overlap during the backfill window.
jess: will add compaction-resilience to the patch (idempotency + retry semantics).
maya: cool. reconvene Thu 3pm PT for sync. :calendar:
kevin: :thumbsup:
jess: :thumbsup:
data-eng: ack
sre-rotation: thanks — I'll keep an eye on oncall alerts and escalate if anything changes
